title: Run validity classification
description: The classification.json sealed into every evidence bundle: whether the run's evidence is valid, which checks were deliberately not performed, and why the bundle cannot support a claim. This is the validity axis, deliberately separate from kafkars.run-status.v1 execution_status - a complete run can be invalid, and a partial run can still carry valid per-subject evidence. Written by crates/benchctl and modeled in crates/bench-verifier; documentation mirror of the Classification serde type in crates/bench-schema/src/classify.rs, which is the source of truth.

run_valid.description: True only when every subject's evidence passed every performed check.

claim_eligible.description: Always false in milestone 0: no calibrated stable-runner thresholds, no broker or host limiting-resource classification, one balanced producer workload.

reasons.description: Why this subject's evidence is invalid; empty when valid.

deferred_checks.description: Checks the milestone-0 engine does not perform, recorded explicitly rather than silently skipped: bootstrap confidence intervals and suites, latency-CSV row validation, native-metric gates, librdkafka statistics summaries, gzip evidence compression, and /usr/bin/time process resources. The legacy Node control plane remains the behavioral reference for each.

reasons.description: Run-level reasons the evidence is invalid or claim-ineligible.
